classification.difficultyReason: Complete supplied reason scaffolds and apply a single parallel-line relationship to each unknown.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of the missing angle and give a reason.

spec.description: Descending parallel lines, rising transversal, two interior sectors on its right, and a white rectangular response mask. Final-size repair: unfilled writing box placed to the right of all geometry, with a thin pointer from the requested sector;65mm overall width preserves handwriting dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Co-interior angles: 110° + unknown = 180°. Drawing coordinates describe the source orientation, not additional measured givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Show 110° only; leave the lower angle box empty.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Missing angle}&=180^\circ-110^\circ\\&=70^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles between parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Gently rising parallels with a descending transversal; alternate interior sectors and a white writing box left of the lower intersection. spec.mathematics: The missing alternate interior angle equals 62°.
spec.answerVisibility: Show 62°; keep the response box empty.

answer.worked: The missing angle is $62^\circ$ because alternate angles between parallel lines are equal.
